estimates.assumptions: 4 medium carrots (approx 500g total), raw, peeled and sliced; using standard carrot nutrition (36 kcal/100g)
1/2 medium red cabbage (approx 500g), raw and shredded; using standard red cabbage nutrition (28 kcal/100g)
2 medium red onions (approx 220g total), raw and sliced; using standard red onion nutrition (27 kcal/100g)
small handful fresh mint leaves (approx 10g); modest estimate for 'handful' using standard mint nutrition
small handful fresh coriander leaves (approx 10g); modest estimate for 'handful' using standard coriander nutrition
small handful roasted peanuts (approx 30g); modest estimate for 'handful' using standard roasted peanut nutrition (unsalted)
juice of 2 limes (approx 60ml total); using standard lime juice nutrition
1 tablespoon groundnut oil (15ml); using standard peanut oil nutrition (all used in dressing)
1 red chilli (approx 20g), chopped; using standard fresh red chilli nutrition
1 tablespoon brown sugar (12g); using standard brown sugar nutrition
